00219 inline JuceIOHostInternal::JuceIOHostInternal(JuceIOHost *owner, 
00220              const int numInputs, 
00221              const int numOutputs, 
00222              const int preferredBufferSize, 
00223              const bool useTimerDeleter) throw()
00224 : owner_(owner),
00225  numInputs_(numInputs < 0 ? 0 : numInputs),
00226  numOutputs_(numOutputs < 0 ? 0 : numOutputs),
00227  bufferSize(preferredBufferSize),
00228  juceDeleter(0)
00229 {
00230  ugen_assert(numInputs == numInputs_);
00231  ugen_assert(numOutputs == numOutputs_);
00232  ugen_assert(bufferSize == preferredBufferSize);
00233  
00234  const ScopedLock sl(lock);
00235  UGen::initialise();
00236  if(useTimerDeleter) 
00237  {
00238   juceDeleter = new JuceTimerDeleter();
00239   UGen::setDeleter(juceDeleter);
00240  }
00241  
00242 #ifndef UGEN_NOEXTGPL
00243  Ran088::defaultGenerator().setSeed(Time::currentTimeMillis());
00244 #endif
00245  startTimer(50);
00246  
00247  output_ = Plug::AR(UGen::emptyChannels(numOutputs_), false);
00248 }

00250 inline JuceIOHostInternal::~JuceIOHostInternal()

00255 }

00257 inline void JuceIOHostInternal::timerCallback()
00258 {
00259  stopTimer();
00260  
00261  String error = audioDeviceManager.initialise (numInputs_, numOutputs_, 0, true);
00262  
00263  if (error.isNotEmpty())
00264  {
00265   AlertWindow::showMessageBox (AlertWindow::WarningIcon, 
00266           T("JuceIOHostInternal"), 
00267           T("AudioDeviceManager init failed \n\n") + error);
00268   
00269   return;
00270  }
00271  
00272  AudioDeviceManager::AudioDeviceSetup setup;
00273  audioDeviceManager.getAudioDeviceSetup(setup);
00274  
00275  if(bufferSize < 1)
00276  {
00277   bufferSize = setup.bufferSize;
00278  }
00279  else
00280  {
00281   setup.bufferSize = bufferSize;
00282   audioDeviceManager.setAudioDeviceSetup(setup, false);
00283  }
00284  
00285  if (error.isNotEmpty())
00286  {
00287   AlertWindow::showMessageBox (AlertWindow::WarningIcon, 
00288           T("JuceIOHostInternal"), 
00289           T("AudioDeviceManager setup failed \n\n") + error);
00290   
00291   return;
00292  }
00293  
00294  const ScopedLock sl(lock);
00295  
00296  if(numInputs_ > 0)
00297   input_ = AudioIn::AR(numInputs_);
00298  audioDeviceManager.addAudioCallback (this); 
00299 }

00301 inline void JuceIOHostInternal::audioDeviceIOCallback (const float** inputChannelData,
00302                 int numInputChannels, 
00303                 float** outputChannelData, 
00304                 int numOutputChannels, 
00305                 int numSamples)
00306 {
00307  // may need to be a bit cleverer with the channels in here..
00308  const ScopedLock sl(lock);
00309  
00310  int blockID = UGen::getNextBlockID(numSamples);
00311  
00312  if(numInputs_ > 0)
00313   input_.setInputs(inputChannelData, numSamples, numInputChannels);
00314  
00315  if(numOutputs_ > 0)
00316  {
00317   output_.setOutputs(outputChannelData, numSamples, numOutputChannels);
00318   
00319   for(int i = 0; i < others.size(); i++)
00320   {
00321    others[i].prepareAndProcessBlock(numSamples, blockID);
00322   }
00323   
00324   output_.prepareAndProcessBlock(numSamples, blockID);
00325  }
00326  else
00327  {
00328   for(int i = 0; i < others.size(); i++)
00329   {
00330    others[i].prepareAndProcessBlock(numSamples, blockID);
00331   }
00332  }
00333 }
